bins.noshebang:
# Fake `docker` (D23 golden): argv to <verb>.argv, then <verb>.sh.
d="$FAKE_DOCKER_DIR"
v="$1"
printf '%s\000' "$@" > "$d/$v.argv"
out() { /bin/cat "$d/$v.out"; }
err() { /bin/cat "$d/$v.err" >&2; }
if [ -f "$d/$v.sh" ]; then . "$d/$v.sh"; fi
printf 'fake docker: no script for %s\n' "$v" >&2
exit 97
